notes.title: [Update 1.7] Hola! Hallo! Hej!
notes.notes:
Hurray! Veranoia is now available in:

- Se agregó el idioma español al juego. (Spanish Language)
- Deutsche Sprache zum Spiel hinzugefügt (Deutsch Language)
- Tyska språket har lagts till i spelet (Swedish Language)

Also an option change/modify back to English language realtime while playing.
Enjoy! <3

notes.title: New Update/HotFix 1.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/c5df1373758d5122096e227e1362f5dc33994534.png[/img]

Based on your feedbacks I've added the following:
* Full graphic settings option (ingame and in main menu)
* You can see current graphic setting and how it effects realworld (realtime)
* Some hints for cave entry improved (Lighting)
* First NPC is now walk-through
Thank you!
